```yaml
---
id: vuln-jackson-databind-3d971539
languages:
  - java
message: Potential deserialization of untrusted data
severity: ERROR
metadata:
  cve: CVE-2020-24616
  cwe: CWE-502
pattern: |
  $s = new HashSet<String>();
  ...
  $s.add("br.com.anteros.dbcp.AnterosDBCPDataSource");
  ...
  DEFAULT_NO_DESER_CLASS_NAMES = Collections.unmodifiableSet(s);
```
This Semgrep rule will detect the creation of a new HashSet and adding of potentially untrusted classes to it. The rule is written in Java and it uses the Semgrep pattern language. The pattern `$s = new HashSet<String>();` matches the creation of a new HashSet. The pattern `$s.add("br.com.anteros.dbcp.AnterosDBCPDataSource");` matches the addition of a potentially untrusted class to the HashSet. The pattern `DEFAULT_NO_DESER_CLASS_NAMES = Collections.unmodifiableSet(s);` matches the assignment of the unmodifiable version of the HashSet to a constant.
